goal: Add opt-in apply-to-existing control to account Edit. Saving future-only must preserve all existing expiries. ON spec change queues paced owned-server replacement; desired-only growth never rotates, desired shrink ON retires exact excess earliest expiry, OFF waits natural expiry. Shared provider-neutral durable reconciliation, idempotent and failure-safe.
context: Canonical 4a63cc8 runtime43e8c66 migration157. Latest user rejects automatic rotation on every Save. Default OFF. Desired changes separate from immutable build spec (regions/plans/images/fallback/lifetime). Only ON plus actual spec change starts rollout; ON desired-only shrink removes excess only, OFF cancels unstarted rollout. Preserve old expires_at. Persist rules revision on deployment reservation under deployment-admission lock; new builds always latest. Existing scheduler handles desired deficit and backfill. Add durable per-account control/revision/target/waiting/next action, owned READY earliest expiry claims. No unrelated cloud mutations during tests. Existing provider/proxy/create-denial gates respected; test PostgreSQL, duplicate Save, concurrent claims, no premature delete when replacement unready, future-only lifetime, desired +/-1, restart, rollback. New toggle remains OFF across deployment. Use local source and server API plan; no delegation.
commit_message: feat(accounts): make existing-server rule application opt-in
